meta.title: Buyer at a multi-location resort retailer
meta.industry: Resort retail, six shops across two resorts
meta.blurb: Buys apparel, gifts and sundries for the resort shops and manages vendor relationships.

opportunities.why: You get a high volume of email from vendors and shop managers in Outlook and answer similar repeat questions yourself.
opportunities.firstStep: Turn on the inbox summary each morning and copy its action items into your to-do list for a week.
opportunities.failureMode: Summaries miss the one message that mattered, so important senders still need a rule that flags them.

habits.name: Grouping similar tasks
becauseTasks: Outlook: Triage the inbox, Answer vendor questions, Chase late shipments
Excel: Check sell-through by shop, Build the weekly sales report, Reconcile vendor invoices against receipts
habits.firstStep: Put the tasks that use the same tool into one block on your calendar.
habits.failureMode: Blocks get booked over unless they are marked busy.

rules.name: Task is in the task map
Quoted evidence appears word for word in the visitor's answers
Pattern is in the catalog and every required signal was recorded
Tool is listed on the pattern, with a working link checked within the limit
Hours figures are the ones code computed
A working-habit suggestion carries no hours unless the catalog supplies a share

transcript.question: How many emails do you go through for "Triage the inbox" on a typical day?
For "Triage the inbox", who do most emails come from, and where do they go after sorting?
options: Internal staff; I file into folders
Mixed senders; I reply or forward
transcript.answer: Vendors and shop managers; I reply myself to the repeat questions on ship dates and reorder status.

transcript.question: How many purchase orders do you write per week in "Write purchase orders", and what do you base them on?
options: Over 30, from stock levels in NetSuite

transcript.question: For "Chase late shipments", how many shipments do you chase per week, and how do you learn they're late?
In "Write purchase orders", where do the finished orders go?
For "Chase late shipments", who receives your follow-ups once you've chased a shipment?
transcript.answer: Vendors and freight carriers, mostly. I track their replies in a spreadsheet.
